label: Sky Stage
description: The sky as an aviation stage — cloud architecture and air, written from altitude rather than from the ground.

items.name: cumulus-canyons
items.text: towering cumulus canyons, sunlit cauliflower walls with shadowed gorges of clear air running between them

items.name: anvil-distance
items.text: a single anvil-topped thunderhead standing at distance, its shadow laid across the haze layer below

items.name: cirrus-sheet
items.text: a high mackerel sheet of cirrus, thin silver light spread perfectly even across the frame

items.name: polar-blue
items.text: hard polar blue, air so dry and clean the horizon shows its faint curve at altitude

items.name: broken-stratus-rays
items.text: broken stratus with god-rays dropping through the gaps to a patchwork of ground far below

items.name: golden-haze-layer
items.text: a golden haze layer lying on the horizon, the low sun ballooning soft and enormous where it meets it

items.name: lenticular-stack
items.text: a stack of lenticular clouds hovering lens-on-lens in the mountain wave, edges machined smooth by the wind

items.name: squall-line
items.text: an advancing squall line, a rolling shelf cloud dragging its grey curtain of rain across half the sky

items.name: contrail-lattice
items.text: deep blue crossed by an old lattice of spreading contrails, fresh white lines cutting the softened ones

items.name: moonlit-cloud-floor
items.text: a moonlit cloud floor rolling silver to the horizon under hard unblinking stars
